subject.title: fix(agents-bind): generate peer format for feishu group bindings

question: Which Feishu bind grammar should OpenClaw support before this PR or a sibling candidate lands?
rationale: The central bug is real, but `--bind <channel>:<value>` is already a public account-binding contract and the competing PRs choose different compatibility shapes.

options.title: Preserve account syntax and add explicit peer grammar
options.body: Keep `feishu:<account>` as account binding and add a documented explicit peer form or migration-safe parser path for Feishu conversation IDs.

options.title: Infer Feishu conversation IDs by pattern
options.body: Treat only recognizable Feishu conversation ID prefixes as peers while leaving unknown values on the existing account path.

options.title: Accept the new account escape
options.body: Adopt this PR's `feishu:account:<id>` escape and own the upgrade/docs burden for existing Feishu account-bind users.

recommendation.title: Preserve account syntax and add explicit peer grammar
recommendation.body: Keep `feishu:<account>` as account binding and add a documented explicit peer form or migration-safe parser path for Feishu conversation IDs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent routing/docs provenance and current-file history around the public bind contract affected by the choice.
